+title: 'git: tools.git.show and tools.git.log'
+---
+## Goal
+
+Add two read verbs that the sah MCP tool does not have (git.md, "Verbs"). `show` is also the blob reader that `tools.git.diff` uses for `path@ref`.
+
+## Work
+
+1. A shared internal reader: `blob(path:ref:) -> content or correction`. The path goes through the `PathGuard` of `GitContext`. A binary blob is a correction ("binary file"), not text.
+2. `Show` verb (`name = "show"`). Arguments: `path: String`, `ref: String?` (default `HEAD`). Result: `path`, `ref`, `content: String?`, `correction: String?`. Keep a size cap in the pattern of `tools.files.read`, and report when the cap cut the content.
+3. `Log` verb (`name = "log"`). Arguments: `ref: String?` (default `HEAD`), `path: String?` (only commits that change this path), `limit: Int?` (default and maximum to decide; for example 20 and 200). Result: `commits` (each: `sha`, `shortSha`, `author`, `date` in ISO 8601, `subject`), `capped: Bool`, `correction: String?`.
+4. Add both verbs to `GitCapability.tools`.
+
+## Tests
+
+Use the temporary-repository helper.
+- `show` at `HEAD`, at an older commit, at a branch name; unknown ref; unknown path; path outside the root; binary file; content over the cap.
+- `log` with no arguments, with `limit`, with `path`, on a branch; unknown ref.
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- `swift build` and `swift test` pass with no new warnings. #git
\ No newline at end of file

+    - Plan for the shared reader: `GitContext.blob(path:ref:) -> Result<GitBlob, CorrectiveRejection>` in a new file `GitBlobReader.swift`. It goes: repository -> `pathGuard.validatePath` -> `GitRepositoryLocation.repositoryPath(ofFile:)` -> LibGit2 layer `blob(atPath:revision:)`. The layer gives an enum (found / unknown revision / unknown path / not a file), because libgit2 gives `GIT_ENOTFOUND` for both an unknown ref and an unknown path.
+    - `validatePath`, not `validate(_:for: .read)`: the file at an older ref can be absent from the work folder. The guard accepts a missing file when its parent folder exists.
+    - Discovery: `resolvedPath(_:)` (realpath) gives the input unchanged for a missing file. Thus `repositoryPath(ofFile:)` gets `/var/...` against a `/private/var/...` work folder and gives nil. Fix: when the file is missing, resolve the parent folder and add the last name.
+    - Log plan: revwalk from the commit of `ref` (`git_revparse_single` + peel to commit), sort topological + time; path filter = tree diff to the first parent (root commit: to no tree) with a pathspec and `GIT_DIFF_DISABLE_PATHSPEC_MATCH` (a literal path). Read limit + 1 commits to set `isCapped`. Limit range 1...200, default 20.
+    - Naming rule `swift/naming-clarity`: the card field `capped` becomes `isCapped` (the same as `BlameResult.isCapped`).
+    - The author-and-date read of a commit (now private in `LibGit2Blame.swift`) moves to one shared helper, so blame and log do not hold two copies.

+    Decisions inside the card:
+    - Shared reader: `GitContext.blob(path:ref:) -> Result<GitBlob, CorrectiveRejection>` (`GitBlobReader.swift`). `GitBlob` = root-relative `path` + whole `text` (no cap; each verb caps). Binary = `git_blob_is_binary` (NUL byte) OR not UTF-8. Also shared: `GitContext.repositoryPath(of:in:)` (guard + work-folder path), `GitContext.defaultRef = "HEAD"`, `GitContext.unknownRefMessage(_:)`, `GitContext.outsideWorkFolderDescription` (Blame now reads it).
+    - LibGit2 layer: `LibGit2Commit.swift` (shared `LibGit2Commit` {sha, author, date, subject}, `formattedDate`, `commit(forRevision:)` -> nil for GIT_ENOTFOUND, `commitFacts(withID:)`, `withCommit(id:_:)`, `facts(of:)`); `LibGit2Blob.swift` (`blob(atPath:revision:) -> LibGit2BlobLookup` .found/.unknownRevision/.unknownPath/.notAFile); `LibGit2Log.swift` (`log(fromRevision:touching:limit:) -> LibGit2Log?`, revwalk TOPOLOGICAL|TIME, path filter = tree diff to first parent with pathspec + GIT_DIFF_DISABLE_PATHSPEC_MATCH, reads limit+1 for `hasMore`).
+    - `LibGit2BlameCommit` is gone: blame uses `LibGit2Commit` and `commitFacts(withID:)`, and `Blame.dateStyle` moved to `LibGit2Commit.formattedDate`. Thus the author/date read and the date form are in one place.
+    - Show: `lineCap = 1_000` lines in git's line model (`GitPatch.lines`), `isCapped`; result {path, ref, content?, isCapped, correction?}.
+    - Log: `defaultLimit = 20`, `LogArguments.limitRange = 1...200` (guide + `BoundParameter`), `shortSha` = first 7 hex; result {commits, isCapped, correction?}. Card field `capped` is `isCapped` (swift/naming-clarity).
+    - Tests: `GitTestHistory.swift` (test target) holds the two shared histories, so the layer suites and the verb suites do not copy the builders.
+
+    Discoveries:
+    - `GitRepositoryLocation.repositoryPath(ofFile:)` gave nil for a file that is absent from the disk (realpath fails, `/var` vs `/private/var`). Fixed: resolve the folder and add the name. New test in GitContextTests.
+    - The guard (`validatePath`) refuses a path whose FOLDER is absent from the work folder. Thus show/log of a file in a folder that a later commit removed gives a correction. Out of scope for this card; recorded as new task ^5a8vaqk.
+    - The pathspec with GIT_DIFF_DISABLE_PATHSPEC_MATCH still matches a folder prefix (`src` matches `src/b.txt`); the test proves it.
